listing.aiSummary: Adds over 20 hullmods with dynamic tooltips, combat effects, and subsystem upgrades.

description:
Advanced Modifications

Adds over 20+ Hullmods with dynamic tooltips and combat effects
to expand build possibilities!

Download
(Can be added to existing save!)
(Also works with 0.98a+)

Requires:

LazyLib

MagicLib

GraphicsLib

Things to expect:

-High-risk high-reward type modifications.

-Mid combat effects to turn the tides!

-Not just stat change, also custom VFX and special effects!.

-Hullmods with special material requirements.

Spoiler
Materials used to install hullmods are NOT recovered when uninstalling them,
This is intended to force people into thinking twice before making a decision,
however the engine will remember what ship equipped what hullmod (even if destroyed and recovered)
and you will never have to spend materials to reinstall the same hullmod on the same ship again
(This is reflected in the dynamic tooltip before installing the Hullmod)

-Subsystems for upgrading Hullmod effects!

Hullmods:

Spoiler

Subsystems:

Spoiler
Sometimes while salvaging a research or a mining station you might be lucky and find a Subsystem!

1- Alpha Subsystem

2- Delta Subsystem

When combined with other "Advanced Hullmods" they result in interesting effects!
"Advanced Hullmods" supports full dynamic tooltip, when installing a Subsystem
the tooltip will show upgrade effects (if any) and change parameters accordingly.

Upgrade combinations:

Spoiler
An "index" listing all upgrade paths with Subsystems.

Combat Analyzer + Alpha Subsystem

-It's all about the waiting game.

Dedicated Weapons CPU + Alpha Subsystem

-For those who care about efficiency.

Weapon Control Supercomputer + Alpha Subsystem

-Win the flux war!

Crystalized Armor + Delta Subsystem

-Armor power!

Delta Shield + Delta Subsystem

-Defense at any cost!

Emergency System + Delta Subsystem

-We all believe in 3rd chances!

Enhanced Structure + Delta Subsystem

-For when you want best of the best.

Flux Shield Matrix + Alpha Subsystem

-For those of decisive action.

Flux Shield Matrix + Delta Subsystem

-Unbreakable!

Flux Core Overdrive + Alpha Subsystem

-Enemies hate this trick.

Fusion Cores + Alpha Subsystem

-Paragon's best friend!

Galvanized Armor + Delta Subsystem

-Stand your ground!

Hypervelocity Acceleration + Alpha Subsystem

-They feel safe behind their armor, jokes on them.

Nano Hull + Delta Subsystem

-Hull is the new Armor!

Uniformed Missile Design + Alpha Subsystem

-Hit them fast AND hard!

Uniformed Missile Design + Delta Subsystem

-No PD will be enough!

Balance:

While listening to feedback i learnt that aiming toward perfect balance is simply impossible since everyone wants something,
hence i decided to release this mod as uncompiled source code to give you the ability to change it yourself!
any change in variables will be cascaded to dynamic tooltip even while using a Subsystem.

Changelog:

Spoiler
-v1.3.1
-Crash hotfix.
-v1.3
- Dedicated Weapons CPU:
Added Alpha Subsystem upgrade.

- Flux Shield Matrix:
Added Alpha Subsystem upgrade.
Improved visuals and sound effects.
Now has custom color change when used with Delta Subsystem.

- Uniformed Missile Design:
No longer improves Missile turn speed and turn Acceleration.
SMod no longer provides Increased Missile weapon capacity.
Smod instead provides 20% Increased Missiles turn speed and turn Acceleration.

- Vista Circuits:
Peak performance reduction is now multiplicative with other sources.
No longer has an SMod bonus.
Initial timeflow reduced to 7%(from 10%).
Maximum timeflow reduced to 15%(from 20%).
System effectiveness is now tied to the lowest hull the ship ever reached during deployment (instead of current).
Fixed a bug with combat-tooltip not accounting for damaged hull.

- Nanohull:
SMod no longer provides damage reduction.
SMod instead improves flux efficiency by 20%.
Delta Subsystem upgrade no longer improves flux efficiency.
Delta Subsystem upgrade instead provides 10% Hull damage reduction scaling with missing hull (up to 20%).

-Total Shield conversion modifications no longer interfers with the color of shields when combined with [REDACTED] Hullmods.
-Tooltip adjustments for various Hullmods.

-v1.2a
-Advanced Hullmods with item requirements can now be installed for free on modules (Parent ship is unaffected by this change).
-Many code optimizations.

-v1.2
-Updated mod compatibility for version: 0.98.5a+.
(You can still use updated version of the mod on previous version(s) of the game).

-Added Proton Wall System to the Game.
-Added Flux Shield Matrix to the game.
Added Delta Subsystem upgrade to Flux Shield Matrix.

- Infinity Targeting Core
Fixed a bug with network size calculation for enemy ships.
Fixed a bug that caused smaller ships to go beyond the intended extra range cap from network scaling.
Updated Hullmod tooltip to reflect maximum range bonus attainable via Network scaling across all hullsizes.

- Delta Shield
Fixed a bug that caused shield Arc to be locked incorrectly when used with Delta Subsystem.
Fixed a bug causing the shield to retain improved damage reduction value after removing Delta Subsystem from the ship.

- Crystalized Armor
Damage reduction gained from secondary effect is now multiplicative with other sources.
Added custom VFX color change when used with Delta Subsystem.

- Weapon Control Supercomputer
Fixed compatibility with other Hullmods (opps).

- Combat Analyzer
Increased OP cost on cruisers.
Reduced OP cost Frigates and Destroyers.

- Emergency System
Increased Repair rate (2% --> 3%) when used with Delta subsystem.

-Fixed an exploit that allowed players to invest significantly less item requirements to install hullmods by having 2 cargo stacks of different sizes of the same required item in their inventory.
-Fixed a bug that forced the player to re-invest materials for installing Advanced Hullmods that were already installed on ships recovered from enemy fleets.

-v1.1
- Nanohull:
Fixed a major bug with flux dissipation penalty applying in reverse (opps).

- Crystalized Armor:
Reduced OP cost on smaller ships (Frigates and Destroyers).

-Advanced hullmods are now filtered and sorted by tags in the Codex.
-Various tooltip optimizations for clarity.

-v1.0
Mod release

Credits:

Big thanks to Spectros and everyone else on the unofficial SS discord whom have provided their feedback
and helped me balance this mod as much as possible!

AI use disclaimer
None of the content featured in this mod is made with AI, all code is hand written and manually checked for bugs.

Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License.
